prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Storybook Visual Path Carousel: Redesign the path selection screen into a visual carousel format with animated path cards.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Choose Your Pet's Journey", "body": "Browse different companion paths to find the experience that fits your desktop style best.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Path Selector", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
1: [sign_in, new_screen] Cloud Account Sync Pre-Sign In Screen: Insert a dedicated pre-sign-in info screen explaining cloud save protection so users sign in with the correct existing account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "new_account_restore_guide", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_account_restore_guide": {"headline": "Keep Your Pet Safe Across Devices", "body": "Signing in links your pet data and unlocked items to your account so you never lose progress.", "layout": "centered", "button_label": "Continue to Sign In"}, "sign_in": {"hint": "Use your primary login to restore any existing pet automatically."}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Photo Validation Sandbox Flow: Rebuild the photo upload screen with real-time photo quality validation and interactive 3D rendering preview.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Pet Photo Creator & Live Preview", "body": "Upload a clear front-facing photo to generate your 3D desktop pet.", "components": [{"type": "photo_picker", "label": "Upload Photo", "style": "rounded", "action": "next"}, {"type": "preview", "label": "Live 3D Rendering", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
3: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Tray Control Tutorial: Add an explicit post-onboarding tutorial screen showing how to summon, minimize, and talk to the pet from the system tray.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_desktop_tray_tutorial"], "new_desktop_tray_tutorial": {"headline": "How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Right-click your pet on the desktop or use the taskbar tray icon anytime to minimize, feed, or chat.", "layout": "spotlight", "button_label": "Got It!"}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Recovery Login Hint: Display a prominent hint on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to sign in with their original credentials.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Welcome Back to Desktop Pet", "hint": "Already adopted a pet before? Sign in with the same email to restore your companion instantly."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Taskbar Diagnostic Waiting Indicator: Show an active status timer and taskbar tray loading status while the app renders the pet on the desktop.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Initializing Desktop Companion Environment", "body": "Preparing pet graphics in your desktop tray. If hidden, click the tray arrow on your taskbar.", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 5}}
6: [choose_path, incentive] Starter Companion Accessory Reward Badge: Add a prominent reward badge offering a free starter accessory kit upon selecting an onboarding path.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Path & Unlock Starter Items", "body": "Choose a path now to claim a free hat and toy pack for your desktop pet.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Includes Free Welcome Starter Kit", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [adoption, redesign] Official Adoption Certificate Signing Stage: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a stage layout with a name input field and interactive adoption stamp.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Give your desktop pet a name and stamp your official adoption paper.", "replace": {"certificate": [{"role": "certificate", "type": "name_input", "label": "Pet Name", "style": "large"}, {"role": "certificate", "type": "badge", "text": "Official Adoption Seal", "style": "emphasis"}]}}}
8: [choose_path, copy] Fast-Track Onboarding Path Explanation: Clarify in the body copy that choosing a path is fast and reversible later from settings.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "How Would You Like to Start?", "body": "Pick Quick Match to adopt instantly, or Custom Creator to craft a pet. You can change this anytime later.", "hint": "Takes less than 1 minute to complete."}}
9: [finish, notification] Pet Desktop Shortcut Toggle Notification: Display a notification tip banner highlighting hotkey shortcuts for showing and hiding the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Your desktop companion is now active. Use shortcuts or double click to interact.", "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to show or hide your pet on screen!", "style": "playful"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns choose_path into a visual carousel while maintaining both adopt and make options.
Inserts an informational pre-sign-in screen without skipping or removing required steps.
Redesigns photo upload screen with validation preview while maintaining the screen's core job.
Adds a post-onboarding tutorial screen after home_intro, which is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Adds a helpful sign-in hint without altering pricing, flow order, or violating fair design rules.
Shows diagnostic wait time during actual rendering, which is allowed as a real wait time indicator.
Mentions free extras ('free hat and toy pack', 'Free Welcome Starter Kit') in onboarding copy.
Redesigns the adoption certificate screen while preserving the official adoption seal and pet naming job.
Updates copy on choose_path while continuing to offer both quick adoption and custom creation.
Adds a hotkey notification tip banner inside the home_intro onboarding screen.
